# Nexora – BITM College Academic Resources

> Nexora is an unofficial academic repository for BITM students providing organized semester notes, previous year question papers (PYQs), and study materials.

## Sections
- [/resources](/resources): Curated academic notes, syllabus books, and study materials organized by department, year, and semester.
- [/pyqs](/pyqs): Previous year question papers for mid-terms and end-semester VTU / autonomous exams.
- [/quick-links](/quick-links): Official portal links, academic calendar, results portals, and VTU links.
- [/contribute](/contribute): Community document upload and submission desk for students.
